repos_data.description: Calendar sync tool & universal calendar MCP server. Aggregate, sync and control calendars on Google, Outlook, Office 365, iCloud, CalDAV or ICS.

Free, open-source desktop calendar widget for macOS. Google Calendar, iCloud, Outlook, Apple Reminders, Canvas, Blackboard, Brightspace, Moodle, Schoology, Todoist, Asana & Trello in one place, plus menu bar quick add.
